contentText: Details remains murky regarding the "Board of Peace" on Gaza that US President Donald Trump has invited world leaders to join. "The understanding is that Trump is attempting single-handedly to put into place something his advisors Steve Bannon and Miller have suggested, which is basically without openly saying so, to replace the UN," FRANCE 24 Correspondent Noga Tarnopolsky said, reporting from Jerusalem.
